pictures.author: Moonik
pictures.observed: Garden-side raised stone basement with pointed arch recesses; broad canopy/gold-toned soffit, blue upper tiles, pale lower marble panels, two rows of windows, three tall pale glazed arched bay openings and balcony balustrade.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Open pointed arcade, round grey shafts, pale faceted capitals with gold collars, iron ties, geometric open marble railing, blue tiled wall above pale lower panels and dark lower windows with gold geometric grilles.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Kiosk is right of the pool; open court-facing arches and white railing meet blue tiled room walls under broad lead canopy. Pointed roof stack remains above the eaves; independent Iftar baldachin/pool and foreground Revan arcade are not part of this model.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Baghdad Kiosk as a distinct notched canopy footprint with cross-shaped blue-tiled room, open pointed colonnade and white geometric terrace rails, raised stone basement with recessed pointed openings, tall glazed garden bay, two window levels, broad lead hip/eaves, shallow central lead dome and small pointed roof stack. No independent Iftar/Yerevan kiosk, pool, surrounding terrace, copied artwork or furnishings.
